WITH monthly_average AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', book_date) AS month_start, AVG(total_amount) AS average_amount FROM aviation.bookings GROUP BY date_trunc('month', book_date)) SELECT b.book_ref, b.book_date, b.total_amount FROM aviation.bookings AS b JOIN monthly_average AS m ON m.month_start = date_trunc('month', b.book_date) WHERE b.total_amount > m.average_amount * 1.5 ORDER BY b.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100

WITH monthly_average AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', book_date) AS month_start, AVG(total_amount) AS average_amount FROM aviation.bookings GROUP BY date_trunc('month', book_date)) SELECT b.book_ref, b.book_date, b.total_amount FROM aviation.bookings AS b JOIN monthly_average AS m ON m.month_start = date_trunc('month', b.book_date) WHERE b.total_amount > m.average_amount * 1.5 ORDER BY b.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100

WITH route_revenue AS (SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport) SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, revenue FROM route_revenue WHERE revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM route_revenue) AND revenue >= 40000 ORDER BY revenue DESC

WITH route_month AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS sold, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.scheduled_departure) = 8 GROUP BY month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport) SELECT month_start, departure_airport, arrival_airport, sold, revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS route_rank FROM route_month ORDER BY month_start, route_rank LIMIT 100

WITH route_month AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS sold, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.scheduled_departure) = 8 GROUP BY month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport) SELECT month_start, departure_airport, arrival_airport, sold, revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS route_rank FROM route_month ORDER BY month_start, route_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT scheduled_departure::date AS flight_date, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'TBS' GROUP BY scheduled_departure::date ORDER BY flight_date

WITH passenger_totals AS (SELECT t.passenger_id, t.passenger_name, COUNT(*) AS segments, SUM(tf.amount) AS total_spent FROM aviation.tickets AS t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY t.passenger_id, t.passenger_name) SELECT passenger_id, passenger_name, segments, total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank FROM passenger_totals WHERE total_spent >= 115000 ORDER BY spending_rank LIMIT 100

WITH capacity AS (SELECT aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS seats FROM aviation.seats GROUP BY aircraft_code), sold AS (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM aviation.ticket_flights GROUP BY flight_id) SELECT f.flight_id, f.aircraft_code, c.seats, COALESCE(s.tickets, 0) AS tickets, COALESCE(s.tickets, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(c.seats, 0) AS load_factor FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN capacity AS c ON c.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN sold AS s ON s.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.aircraft_code = 'SU9' ORDER BY load_factor DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH capacity AS (SELECT aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS seats FROM aviation.seats GROUP BY aircraft_code), sold AS (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM aviation.ticket_flights GROUP BY flight_id) SELECT f.flight_id, f.aircraft_code, c.seats, COALESCE(s.tickets, 0) AS tickets, COALESCE(s.tickets, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(c.seats, 0) AS load_factor FROM aviation.flights AS f JOIN capacity AS c ON c.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN sold AS s ON s.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.aircraft_code = 'SU9' ORDER BY load_factor DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT t.passenger_id, tf1.fare_conditions AS first_fare, tf2.fare_conditions AS next_fare, COUNT(*) AS transitions FROM aviation.tickets AS t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf1 ON tf1.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf2 ON tf2.ticket_no = t.ticket_no AND tf2.flight_id > tf1.flight_id WHERE tf1.fare_conditions = 'Business' GROUP BY t.passenger_id, tf1.fare_conditions, tf2.fare_conditions HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY transitions DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT t.passenger_id, tf1.fare_conditions AS first_fare, tf2.fare_conditions AS next_fare, COUNT(*) AS transitions FROM aviation.tickets AS t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf1 ON tf1.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf2 ON tf2.ticket_no = t.ticket_no AND tf2.flight_id > tf1.flight_id WHERE tf1.fare_conditions = 'Business' GROUP BY t.passenger_id, tf1.fare_conditions, tf2.fare_conditions HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY transitions DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS median_fare, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS p90_fare FROM aviation.ticket_flights AS tf JOIN aviation.flights AS f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport

SELECT b.book_ref, b.total_amount, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, SUM(tf.amount) FILTER (WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Economy') AS economy, SUM(tf.amount) FILTER (WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business') AS business FROM aviation.bookings AS b JOIN aviation.tickets AS t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE b.book_date >= DATE '2025-02-10' AND b.book_date < DATE '2025-03-12' GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.total_amount HAVING COUNT(tf.flight_id) >= 2

SELECT b.book_ref, b.total_amount, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, SUM(tf.amount) FILTER (WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Economy') AS economy, SUM(tf.amount) FILTER (WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business') AS business FROM aviation.bookings AS b JOIN aviation.tickets AS t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights AS tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE b.book_date >= DATE '2025-02-10' AND b.book_date < DATE '2025-03-12' GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.total_amount HAVING COUNT(tf.flight_id) >= 2

SELECT b.book_ref, COUNT(t.ticket_no) AS ticket_count FROM aviation.bookings AS b JOIN aviation.tickets AS t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref WHERE b.book_date >= DATE '2025-04-17' AND b.book_date < DATE '2025-05-01' GROUP BY b.book_ref HAVING COUNT(t.ticket_no) >= 2

SELECT departure_airport, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Scheduled') AS scheduled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Departed') AS departed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Arrived') AS arrived, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (scheduled_arrival - scheduled_departure)) / 60) AS average_duration_minutes FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'SVO' GROUP BY departure_airport

WITH sold AS (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS sold_count FROM aviation.ticket_flights GROUP BY flight_id), boarded AS (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS boarded_count FROM aviation.boarding_passes GROUP BY flight_id) SELECT f.flight_id, COALESCE(s.sold_count, 0) AS sold_count, COALESCE(b.boarded_count, 0) AS boarded_count, COALESCE(b.boarded_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.sold_count, 0) AS ratio FROM aviation.flights AS f LEFT JOIN sold AS s ON s.flight_id = f.flight_id LEFT JOIN boarded AS b ON b.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND f.scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-03-22'

WITH sold AS (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS sold_count FROM aviation.ticket_flights GROUP BY flight_id), boarded AS (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS boarded_count FROM aviation.boarding_passes GROUP BY flight_id) SELECT f.flight_id, COALESCE(s.sold_count, 0) AS sold_count, COALESCE(b.boarded_count, 0) AS boarded_count, COALESCE(b.boarded_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.sold_count, 0) AS ratio FROM aviation.flights AS f LEFT JOIN sold AS s ON s.flight_id = f.flight_id LEFT JOIN boarded AS b ON b.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-03-15' AND f.scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-03-22'

WITH route_counts AS (SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'Departed' GROUP BY departure_airport, arrival_airport) SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, flight_count, flight_count::numeric / SUM(flight_count) OVER (PARTITION BY departure_airport) AS traffic_share FROM route_counts ORDER BY traffic_share DESC
